# CRF Sequence Labeler

> A linear-chain conditional random field for sequence labeling, built from scratch: forward-backward training with log-likelihood gradients, Viterbi decoding, and span-level evaluation.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler

## Source

- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/__init__.py): CRF Sequence Labeler - a linear-chain conditional random field from scratch.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/cli.py): Command line interface for the CRF sequence labeler.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/crf.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/crf.py): A linear-chain conditional random field, trained from scratch.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/data.py): A bundled named-entity dataset with BIO tags for demonstration and evaluation.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/evaluation.py): Span-level evaluation for sequence labeling.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/features.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/features.py): Observation feature extraction for the linear-chain CRF.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained CRF tagger.
- [src/crf_sequence_labeler/training.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/crf-sequence-labeler/blob/main/src/crf_sequence_labeler/training.py): Train the CRF by stochastic gradient ascent on the log-likelihood.
